title: “I don’t see myself represented here at all”: User Experiences of Stable Diffusion Outputs Containing Representational Harms across Gender Identities and Nationalities
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to evaluating 'representational harms'—an ethical framework—in AI outputs. It specifically analyzes dehumanization, erasure, and stereotyping, and proposes a 'harm-aware' design approach. This goes beyond a simple ethical considerations section, making ethical evaluation the core of the research.
